import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

out = Path("out")
order = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
con = duckdb.connect()
counts = con.execute("""
    SELECT strftime(crash_date, "%A") AS weekday, count(*)::BIGINT AS crash_count
    FROM read_parquet("./data/crashes.parquet")
    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY weekday
""").fetchdf()
dates = pd.date_range("2013-01-01", "2025-12-31", freq="D")
occurrences = pd.Series(dates.day_name()).value_counts()
df = pd.DataFrame({"weekday": order}).merge(counts, on="weekday", how="left")
df["crash_count"] = df["crash_count"].astype("int64")
df["weekday_dates"] = df["weekday"].map(occurrences).astype("int64")
df["share_percent"] = df["crash_count"] / df["crash_count"].sum() * 100
df["crashes_per_weekday_date"] = df["crash_count"] / df["weekday_dates"]

# Framing 1: total number of reported crashes per weekday.
vals1 = df[["weekday", "crash_count", "share_percent"]]
vals1.to_csv(out / "values_1.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
bars = ax.bar(df.weekday, df.crash_count, color="#2676A5")
ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{v:,.0f}" for v in df.crash_count], padding=3, fontsize=9)
ax.set(title="NYC police-reported crashes by weekday, 2013–2025", ylabel="Number of crashes", xlabel="Day of week")
ax.set_ylim(0, df.crash_count.max() * 1.13)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.22)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(out / "option_1.png", dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)

# Framing 2: average crashes per calendar date of each weekday.
vals2 = df[["weekday", "weekday_dates", "crash_count", "crashes_per_weekday_date"]]
vals2.to_csv(out / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
bars = ax.bar(df.weekday, df.crashes_per_weekday_date, color="#D17A22")
ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{v:.1f}" for v in df.crashes_per_weekday_date], padding=3, fontsize=9)
ax.set(title="Average NYC crashes per weekday date, 2013–2025", ylabel="Average crashes per occurrence of weekday", xlabel="Day of week")
ax.set_ylim(0, df.crashes_per_weekday_date.max() * 1.15)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.22)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(out / "option_2.png", dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)
print(df.to_string(index=False, formatters={"share_percent": "{:.2f}%".format, "crashes_per_weekday_date": "{:.2f}".format}))
print("Total:", int(df.crash_count.sum()), "calendar dates:", len(dates))
'
